body:
HI,

IGN: mrbobstar

I was banned becuase: Speed hacking and yes i do admit to it!

Why I Should be unbanned: I admit but after 1 year i thought that i might be allowed back in i waited and i followed all your rules Except the "hacking part" but i belive a year on i dont hack anymore after i lost my server after being stupied with the hacking and crazy! i hope you unban me this was my favorite server and i wish it could be again just un ban me please! If you reject please tell me how i can redeem myself too help me on my next years appeal! i just want to get back on this amazing server!

Thanks for reading! Please don't reject!
